name: Cone Weave Walk

instructions.description: Arrange several markers in a wide line.
Walk between them using smooth gentle turns.
Keep the head up and shorten steps near each turn.
Finish in a clear area before stopping.

performanceMetrics.notes: Record distance completed while maintaining the intended movement quality.
Record the time performed with comfortable, controlled technique.

variations.variationDescription: Cone Weave Walk — Interval Progression: Alternate manageable work and recovery periods while keeping the same activity.

commentsNotes: Space markers widely enough for controlled turns.
